instructions: Exercise record for Provectus Alternative D. The starter templates were committed in 28ff74b and then removed from the working tree. Their content remains in that commit. The filled records are manifest.json and README.md. No credentials. Pending means not chosen yet. not-exportable means a detail was unavailable and was not replaced with a guess.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Cursor 3.23.23, user-reported and not rechecked in this session. Coding-model display name, user-reported and not independently confirmed: Grok 4.7 High. This is not a verified API model ID. Reasoning: High, selected by the user. Python 3.12.14 with an existing .venv, user-reported and not rechecked in this session. ChatGPT, display name ChatGPT-6.1 Sol High, user-reported and not a verified API model ID, was used before application code and again during review, evaluation design, and submission review. Those later discussions were not individually exported. docs/work-log.md summarizes the decisions and does not contain an API model ID. pytest 9.1.1 is recorded in requirements-dev.txt from the version installed into .venv. Provider API model IDs, temperature, and output limits were not exported. No defaults for those parameters are known, so none are recorded. The user may switch the coding model later for cost; that change has not happened.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: ChatGPT's GitHub connector was attempted during planning. It returned Not Found and made no repository changes. Version and permissions were not provided. The same attempt is recorded as the ChatGPT GitHub connector under tool_and_mcp_settings. That connector is not a Cursor extension. The Cursor extension inventory was not exported and is unavailable; this does not claim that Cursor has zero extensions.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: The original specified Responses API model was gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14. After one controlled comparison, the default became gpt-4.1-2025-04-14. Both use temperature 0, max_output_tokens 1500, store false, and parallel_tool_calls false. Client timeout 20 seconds and max_retries 0. gpt-4.1-mini remains an explicit override. gpt-6-luna was probed and excluded because it rejects temperature. openai 3.24.0 and its installed dependencies stay pinned. fastapi 0.142.2, starlette 1.7.0, and uvicorn 0.54.0 were added without changing those pins. One early live investigation failed and is preserved. Tests use mocks and save response_source mock. SQL errors, timeouts, and truncation stay incomplete. Evidence IDs are investigation-scoped.

skills.notes: The supplied generate-assignment-data skill was not installed as an active Cursor skill. The copy at ai-workflow/reference/generate-assignment-data-SKILL.md was read as a reference when the demo fixture was generated. No project skill was created.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Repository-root AGENTS.md holds the project instructions. No subagents were defined.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No hooks or scripts were added. Nothing runs automatically for this exercise.

prompts_and_rules.notes: 001-bootstrap.md is the saved bootstrap instruction. 002-sql-tool.md is the saved query-tool instruction. 003-sql-review.md is the saved review-fix instruction. 004-agent-loop.md is the saved agent instruction. 005-generate-demo-data.md is the saved demo-data instruction. 006-api-page.md is the saved API and page instruction. ai-workflow/demo-data.md records how the demo fixture was generated and checked. investigator/prompts/investigation.md is the application prompt sent to the model. workflow-example.md records the query-tool review correction. The pre-review query tool is snapshots/query-tool-before-review.py.txt. AGENTS.md is the project instruction file. data/domain.md remains the domain source of truth and is not copied here.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: ChatGPT's GitHub connector was asked to read this repository, returned Not Found, and made no repository changes. Its version and permissions were not provided. The same attempt is acknowledged under plugins_and_extensions. It is not a Cursor extension, and no Cursor MCP configuration was exported or added. The Cursor extension inventory remains unavailable.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Live investigate and follow-up commands, and live API requests, read OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment, or from the repository-root .env when the variable is unset. An existing value is not replaced. Replay does not load .env. Listing, loading, and downloading saved reports does not load .env or call the model. The key value is not stored. No permission settings were exported. .gitignore excludes .env and .venv.
